_doc: Registry of code patches. Each id needs a locator in tools/boot.py:PATCHES. Record: id, scope (testbed|release), function, problem, change, validation case ids.

patches.problem: Dev console/admin hotkeys are reset to off at every launch
patches.change: Bool false -> true before SetField isAdmin (1 byte per boot file)

patches.problem: No AI decision visibility in release build
patches.change: Appended logger/describer/wrapper functions; redirected call sites (tools/inject.py EVENTS + testbed/ailog.json traces)

patches.problem: Vanilla AI has no army awareness: never attacks or contests exposed armies, retreats/heals by distance only, re-rolls its retreat threshold every tick, sieges adjacent villages in parallel; its getUnits busy filter crashes on non-structure Military orders
patches.change: tools/behave.py rules: hunt (Military ArmyFight on an AIEntityGroup; chases and contests of village sieges near our land; supply budget; objective switch), safe-heal (3 healing-key closures wrapped), retreat-terrain (2 getWarzonePowerBalance calls wrapped; balance x terrain x supply), annex-spacing (tryAction->tryArmyAction wrapped), busy-siege (1 op NullCheck->JNull in the getUnits busy closure); undeploy (installed F_Special_2 on hostile land: tryUndeploy(false) + stale noMoveAbilities removed); ability-gate (3 tryUseOrderAbilities balance calls wrapped: 1.0 = no enemy -> no emergency abilities); peace-gate (the tradeRequestReceived call site wrapped: a treaty offer from an at-war faction is refused while our Military order on its structure is in Engage/Action); raid scans every at-war owner's villages (press-target wrapper, map rscan); added ObjectMap globals for state; worm-flee (worm-targeted armies on sand stop their order and move to the nearest rock; Army.playDeathWorm call in Sandworm.tryAttack wrapped to log weaten); pick-life (getUnits calls in tryArmyAction / checkStructures / checkWorldEvents wrapped: armies < 50% life and not fighting removed); no-regen-heal (the Resupply getUnits call in checkUnits wrapped: armies without safe regen and with full supply removed); annex value (Annex target scores: special +30, compactness, x cheapest/cost via getOccupationActionCost, first spice x2 except Fremen/Vernius); Fremen deep-desert ring bonus in the Annex score; desert-step (siege / raid armies draining in the deep desert next to the target move onto the village's side); gather (Engage leaders wait for the pack: checkEngageOrder getActionDesc call wrapped); Fremen ring hold (aimod_ddclean: off-ring Annex candidates dropped while an uncontested ring is open; raid / pillage press skip ring villages); worm hold (worm-moved armies out of vanilla Resupply / mission picks while a worm is near); harvester run (outgunned harvester to a safe field); hunt awareness (capturing armies count half in aimod_react; armed group member first); disengage (Resupply armies fighting a powerless target pulled out); desert-step Engage/Action only; gather never waits for a fleeing prey or in the deep desert; rally (outmatched defenders gather at one point instead of piecemeal fights; heal / flee spots next to the danger off limits); siege position (capture off enemy guns); main-base guns x3 in power measures; discovery relaunch gap; raid waits for a full Annex gauge
